manifest_row.title: Farmers find sweet spot with nutritious, drought-hardy crop

screening.main_topic: A farmers’ cooperative in central Kenya grows drought-hardy sweet potatoes and processes them into food products to support nutrition and farm incomes.
screening.climate_relevance: The article says the cooperative was motivated in part by a report identifying climate change as a threat, and describes sweet potatoes as suited to the region’s hot, dry weather, erratic rainfall, and crop failures.
screening.reason: The main focus is agricultural production, food security, and livelihoods rather than climate change. Climate is nevertheless meaningfully connected to the choice of a drought-resilient crop and the local conditions farmers face.
